purpose: Drei vollständig neue Cenyric-Individuen nach Freigabe des alten Decklöwen
designRequirements: Untereinander und von früheren Katzen deutlich verschiedene Körperbauten, Gesichter, Fellzeichnungen und Posen

variants.title: 1 · Die schmale Späherin
variants.idea: Schlank und kurzhaarig, mit keilförmigem Gesicht, großen Ohren, feinen Tigerstreifen und neugieriger Sitzhaltung.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-body fantasy animal companion portrait for Aleria. Create ONE entirely NEW CENYRIC domestic ship cat as an individual design, not a recoloring or another pose of an existing character. Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Breed invariants: unmistakably ORANGE TABBY with deeper ginger ORANGE tiger markings, a WHITE BELLY and underside, white lower chest. Natural feline anatomy, four legs, full tail, healthy domestic cat proportions. The white abdominal region must be clearly readable in the pose. Orange hue and white coverage are natural, not brown or gray tabby.
Art direction: polished clean anime character illustration with expressive NATURAL feline face, clear dark contours, cel shading and simple stylized fur masses. A large readable complete cat in the foreground with ears, paws and tail safely inside the frame, about 70–75 percent of picture height. Quiet medieval ship setting with simplified wooden deck, soft blue sea and restrained sky, gentle warm daylight, only the prop needed for the pose. No clutter.
Important: this is a new individual with BOTH eyes clear and healthy. Do not copy the old tomcat's cloudy eye, giant neck mane, broad elderly face or stoic square standing pose. No identical youthful cheeky face repeated across designs. The specified build, head shape, markings and pose define this individual's separate identity.
Constraints: one cat only, quadrupedal natural cat, no humans, additional animals, clothing, bandana, eyepatch, collar, hat, tools, weapons, text, lettering, frames, collage or watermark. No photorealism, painted fur texture, watercolor or 3D rendering. No extra legs, fused paws or cropped body parts.
Individual 1 — THE SLENDER SCOUT: a small-to-medium young adult female cat, SLENDER long-legged fine-boned body, short sleek coat, a distinctly NARROW WEDGE-SHAPED face with a slim muzzle and LARGE upright ears. Vivid tangerine ORANGE coat with thin close-set darker ginger MACKEREL TIGER STRIPES. Narrow symmetrical white muzzle blaze, small white chin, broad WHITE chest and belly, white socks. Two clear bright LIME-GREEN almond-shaped eyes, a pink nose. No cheek ruff or mane.
Pose: sitting very upright on a single low wooden deck step, slender long forelegs straight, hindquarters visible to one side, tail curved neatly along the step and fully visible. Head tilted strongly to one side in curious attention, ears pricked, CLOSED mouth, innocent inquisitive expression rather than a smug grin. A clear three-quarter FRONT view reveals her white underside. Quiet blue ocean behind. Silhouette should be tall and light, elegant and alert; this is a new character unlike a stocky shaggy tomcat.

variants.title: 2 · Der runde Kajütenkater
variants.idea: Kompakter, rundköpfiger Kater mit honigorangen Wirbelzeichnungen, viel Weiß und einer gelassenen, seitlich liegenden Pose.

A low wide ROUND silhouette, rounded face and large orange swirl markings must make him unmistakably different from the slim sitting scout and previous standing cats.

variants.title: 3 · Die wilde Sprinterin
variants.idea: Muskulös und drahtig, mit kräftigem Kupferorange, unterbrochenen Streifen, kantigem Gesicht und einer dynamischen Sprungpose.

Individual 3 — THE WILD SPRINTER: a medium-sized athletic adult female cat with a strongly MUSCULAR wiry body, powerful hindquarters, a low broad ANGULAR head and short blunt muzzle, medium ears pointing alertly forward. Deep saturated COPPER-ORANGE coat with a pattern of SHORT BROKEN darker orange TIGER STRIPES and small elongated orange spots on the flanks. White chin, narrow white lower-chest patch merging into a BROAD WHITE BELLY, orange legs with small white toe tips. Pose: caught in a natural SHORT AGILE LEAP from a low plain wooden barrel toward the ship deck, body moving diagonally toward the viewer, both forepaws reaching ahead at different natural heights and both hind legs tucked in a believable feline leap. Tail straight behind then gently curved for balance, entire tail inside frame. Camera at low three-quarter frontal angle so the WHITE BELLY is visible under the body. Entire cat visible with breathing room; crisp anatomy, exactly four legs. One low barrel edge at the side, simple deck below and quiet sea behind. The silhouette must be dynamic, elongated and airborne, completely different from a seated scout, a reclining rounded cat or a standing old tomcat.
